app_subtitle: ANSSI Compliant · NIST SP 800-88 · GPL v3
menu_lang_title: Sélection de la langue / Language selection
err_not_root:
[bold red]ERROR:[/bold red] SecureWipe must be run with administrator privileges.
  → Linux: [bold]sudo python3 securewipe.py[/bold]
  → Windows: Right-click → Run as administrator
disk_system_blocked:
[bold red]ERROR:[/bold red] Disk [bold]{dev}[/bold] is the active system disk.
It cannot be wiped from a running OS.
[yellow]→ Use a LiveUSB to wipe the system disk.[/yellow]
disk_invalid_choice: [red]Invalid choice. Enter a number between 1 and {max}.[/red]
wipe_mode_ssd_info:
[yellow]ℹ Flash/NVMe storage detected.[/yellow] Overwrite methods are [bold red]ineffective[/bold red] on this type of media.
Only compatible methods are shown.
wipe_mode_crypto_info:
[bold green]✓ Encryption detected ({enc}).[/bold green] [bold]Cryptographic Erase[/bold] is recommended:
the encryption key is destroyed, making data instantly inaccessible.
wipe_m1_desc: 1 zero pass + verification. Internal transfers only.
wipe_m3_desc: ATA Secure Erase / NVMe Format firmware command. Highest security level.
wipe_m4_desc: Encryption key destruction. Data instantly inaccessible.
wipe_m5_desc: Configurable N passes. Note: >1 pass provides no benefit on modern drives.
wipe_m5_warn:
[yellow]⚠  WARNING:[/yellow] Multiple passes do not improve security on modern drives
(high recording density). This mode exists for documented compliance reasons.
wipe_m5_passes_invalid: [red]Invalid value. Enter a number between 2 and 7.[/red]
verify_custom_invalid: [red]Invalid value. Enter an integer between 1 and 100.[/red]
confirm_line1: You are about to [bold red]IRREVERSIBLY[/bold red] wipe the following device:
confirm_warn: [bold red]THIS OPERATION IS PERMANENT. NO RECOVERY IS POSSIBLE.[/bold red]
confirm_prompt: Type [bold red]CONFIRM[/bold red] to proceed (or Enter to cancel)
wipe_verify_success: [bold green]✓ Verification passed ({pct}% of sectors checked).[/bold green]
wipe_verify_failed: [bold red]✗ Verification failed — residual data detected.[/bold red]
cert_qr_note: This QR code encodes the report ID, device serial number and certificate SHA-256. It can be verified offline with any standard QR reader.
verify_detail_rand: All blocks are zero — random write may have failed.
nist_unavailable_desc: USB-SATA bridge incompatible with ATA Secure Erase.
removable_nist_msg1: NIST Purge is not available: the USB-SATA bridge blocks ATA Security commands.
nist_blocked_err:
NIST Purge unavailable on removable/USB disk.
USB-SATA bridge blocks ATA Security commands.
→ Use ANSSI Level 2 (direct write) instead.
confirm_vol_close: Close any open files on these drives before confirming.
confirm_vol_isolated: Only these volumes are affected — your other disks remain untouched.
wipe_vol_locked_fail: Volumes that could not be locked: {letters}
wipe_vol_close_hint: Close open files on these volumes if the write fails.
